blocks.title: Taking Away
blocks.body: Imagine you have 5 chocolates. You eat 2. How many are left?

blocks.question: What happens when we SUBTRACT?
blocks.explanation: Subtraction takes away, making the number smaller.

blocks.title: What is Subtraction?
blocks.body: Subtraction is taking one number away from another. We use the minus symbol (-).

blocks.title: Watch the sign!
blocks.body: Make sure you check if it is a PLUS (+) or a MINUS (-). Don't mix them up!

blocks.title: Subtracting Zero
blocks.body: If you take away 0, you lose nothing! (7 - 0 = 7)

blocks.question: There are 9 birds on a tree. 3 fly away. How many are left?
